svg.text: two blades: lenses cut from circles of r 14m,
each blade leans 13° off the centre line
front blade cut free of the back one by m/3
finger rings: r 2m outside, r 1m inside
pivot screw r 0.85m, the one red, ringed by m/3
rings and shanks share one fillet, m/4;
the blades stay sharp, like steel
half-module; centre line through the pivot
Ink + one accent (signal red). Nothing freehand: every curve is from the radius set.
